hero.body: I'm Line Morelle. I build fast, accessible web applications and backend systems with clean code and modern engineering practices.

expertise.label: Expertise
expertise.heading: Technical Capabilities
expertise.frontend_desc: Responsive, accessible, and fast web applications built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern CSS.
expertise.backend_desc: REST and GraphQL APIs, database architecture, authentication, and cloud infrastructure built to scale.
expertise.minimalism_desc: Clean layouts, readable typography, and intuitive user flows designed for clarity and usability.

home_cta.body: Have a project in mind or need an experienced developer for your team? Reach out and let's discuss your timeline and technical requirements.

projects_page.intro: A selection of full-stack web applications, APIs, and client projects built with modern web technologies.
projects_page.philosophy_body: Good software should be intuitive for users and maintainable for developers. I focus on clean code, solid testing, and sensible architecture rather than unnecessary complexity.
projects_page.cta_body: I am open to new client projects, code reviews, and technical consulting. Let's talk about what you are building.

blog.intro: Perspectives on software design, systems scalability, UI craft, and lessons learned building software.
blog.noPosts: No articles published yet. Check back soon!

journey_page.intro: Computer science education, industry-standard certifications, and practical engineering experience building production systems.
journey_page.education_section_subtitle: Degree programs, core computer science coursework, and distributed systems studies.
journey_page.certificates_section_subtitle: Cloud architecture, container orchestration, and professional credentials.
journey_page.philosophy_body: Tools and frameworks evolve quickly, but core software principles - clean abstractions, efficient queries, low latency, and clear documentation - stay the same. I build software designed to stand up to real-world use.
journey_page.pillar1_desc: Type safety, unit testing, and clear error boundaries that keep applications stable.
journey_page.pillar2_desc: Benchmarking real traffic, optimizing Core Web Vitals, and reducing unnecessary load.
journey_page.pillar3_desc: Modular architecture and clear documentation that make code easy for any team to maintain.

services_page.grid_subtitle: End-to-end software development and architectural consulting designed for clarity, speed, and long-term maintainability.
